## ResourceNullabilityResult.note property

A short explanation of an `error` status; of a `no-items` status whose pre-scan stopped at `MAX_PARENT_VISITS` before it looked in every parent; or of a `probed` status whose pre-scan stopped at the time limit, so the items came from only the parents scanned. Never contains an observed value.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly note?: string;
```
